cd /app && python3 -c "
import subprocess
def revcomp(s):
    c={'a':'t','t':'a','g':'c','c':'g','n':'n'}
    return ''.join(c[x] for x in reversed(s))
def tm(seq):
    r=subprocess.run(['oligotm','-tp','1','-sc','1','-mv','50','-dv','2','-n','0.8','-d','500',seq.upper()],capture_output=True,text=True)
    return float(r.stdout.strip())
seqs={};name=None
for line in open('sequences.fasta'):
    line=line.strip()
    if line.startswith('>'): name=line[1:]; seqs[name]=''
    else: seqs[name]+=line
inp=seqs['input']; out=seqs['output']; p=215
up=inp[:p]; down=inp[p:]
I=out[p:p+39]
Lf=18; Lr=37
fwd_anneal=down[:Lf]
rev_anneal=revcomp(up[-Lr:])
I1=I[:19]; I2=I[19:]
tail_F=I2; tail_R=revcomp(I1)
fwd=tail_F+fwd_anneal
rev=tail_R+rev_anneal
tf=tm(fwd_anneal); tr=tm(rev_anneal)
print('fwd',fwd.upper()); print('rev',rev.upper())
print('Lf',Lf,'Tm_f',round(tf,2),'Lr',Lr,'Tm_r',round(tr,2),'diff',round(abs(tf-tr),2))
# reconstruct
recon=up+revcomp(tail_R)+tail_F+down
print('reconstruct==output', recon==out)
open('primers.fasta','w').write('>forward_primer_pair1\n'+fwd.upper()+'\n>reverse_primer_pair1\n'+rev.upper()+'\n')
print(open('primers.fasta').read())
"
